summary: Retest of iteration_27's two UX bugs + full 23-connector Founder UX audit. BOTH BUGS FIXED. Backend: 59/59 pytest cases PASSED (24 iteration_27 regression + 35 iteration_28 new). Frontend: verified in browser as Founder — Founder Mode hides ALL dev credentials (no 'Client ID/Secret/Redirect URI/Needs:'), 21 setup notes visible, 22 publish-reason lines rendered, stripe disabled-Publish title tooltip = 'Stripe powers checkout & payments for QRU Store™ products — it isn't a publishing destination…' AND visible connector-publish-reason-stripe line, 23 connector-next-step-<id> lines rendered. Dev Mode: 22 connector-devconfig-<id> buttons (17 OAuth + 4 api_key + stripe editable) — INCLUDING woocommerce/shopify/amazon_kdp/tpt. Clicking woocommerce Developer Setup opens connect-dialog with connect-apikey-input; clicking youtube opens devconfig-dialog. Youtube OAuth authorize-url returns accounts.google.com endpoint (backend verified). Evidence Dashboard shows LIVE 2/23 Operational Connectors. qru_store Test triggers toast, github Test hidden until dev-config, stripe Test button exists. Cleanup: youtube dev-config deleted; state restored.
critical_code_review_comments: Connectors.js line 152 `{devMode && c.configurable && (...)}` — correctly gated on `configurable` (backend-computed). Good separation of concerns; onClick dispatches to devconfig-dialog (oauth) vs connect-dialog (api_key) based on auth_method.

connectors.py `_publish_reason` now derives reason from (a) can_publish flag, (b) capability check, (c) operational flag, (d) connected flag — never returns None when can_publish=False. Stripe gets a friendly branded message.
connectors.py `_next_step` returns per-status guidance mapped from status → action prompt. Good centralization; consider extracting to a table if more statuses are added.

Connectors.js 22 configurable connectors show connector-cred-needs-<id> in Dev Mode — including stripe (which is env-configured). Slight redundancy but harmless: an admin can rotate the Stripe key via the same dialog if needed.
23 connectors on one page — consider category grouping or a filter for scalability (unchanged since iteration_27; low priority).
developer-mode is client-side state only. Backend enforces super-admin on POST/DELETE /developer-config endpoints (verified). Acceptable defense-in-depth.
